easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability triggers, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.
